q: What grid emission factor should a supplier in Qatar use?
title: Qatar grid factor for suppliers
short: Qatar runs its grid almost entirely on natural gas, with a growing share of solar, so the location based factor sits close to half a kilogram of CO2 per kWh. Use the official or IEA figure for the reporting year, state source and year, and report contracted solar separately under the market based method.
audience: Factories, warehouses and exporters in Mesaieed, Ras Laffan and Doha reporting Scope 2

p: The national average for the year of the bills. Large solar plants added in recent years lower it gradually.
Only contractual instruments that meet the Scope 2 quality criteria change this figure. Without them it equals the grid average.

ul: Both totals, labelled, with factor source and year.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into dated, fingerprinted records and keeps location based and market based figures side by side, each with the factor and year used.
